note: Twelve items, tuned for Iraqi business and personal-brand accounts. Score honestly; most first-pass profiles land in the 30s-40s. Character limits on Instagram fields change; read the live counter in the app instead of trusting a number here.

items.full_marks: The bold name field carries the name plus what they do in words people search, in the language they search it: 'HUS | تسويق وإعلانات بغداد' or 'العريشة | مشاوي بغداد'. Arabic and one English term if the audience searches both.
items.common_fail: Name only, or a name with emoji.

items.full_marks: Line one says who it's for and what changes for them, in Iraqi or clean Arabic: 'نخلي مطعمك يوصل طلبات من إنستا'. Not a job title, not a list.
items.common_fail: 'مصمم | مسوق | صانع محتوى' or a Quran verse / quote as the only line.

items.full_marks: One proof point or one offer, plus the area served (بغداد / كل المحافظات / توصيل).
items.common_fail: Keyword soup, or the phone number written three ways.

items.full_marks: A WhatsApp button or link that opens a chat directly, a working phone, and contact buttons that match how the team actually answers. Someone checks it daily.
items.common_fail: A WhatsApp number typed as text in the bio, or a number nobody answers after 4pm.

items.full_marks: For a physical business: address/area on the profile (location or bio), hours somewhere findable (highlight or bio), map link if it helps. For a service business: 'بغداد' and where they work.
items.common_fail: Customers asking 'وين مكانكم' in every comment.

items.full_marks: Three pinned posts with three jobs: best proof, clearest offer, best introduction to the person/brand.
items.common_fail: Nothing pinned, or three random high-view reels.

items.full_marks: One destination that matches the bio's promise: a WhatsApp catalog, a menu, a booking page, a landing page. Mobile-fast.
items.common_fail: A link tree with ten options, or a dead link.

items.full_marks: 4–6 highlights named for buyer questions: الأسعار / الأعمال / آراء الزبائن / شلون نطلب / الموقع. Consistent covers, nothing stale at the front.
First 9 covers readable at thumbnail size and in the 3:4 grid crop; say what the account is about without a tap. Arabic cover text right-aligned and large.
items.common_fail: Nine covers of a face mid-word, or text cut off by the grid crop.

items.full_marks: Personal brand: face fills ~60% of the circle, recent, clean background. Business: logo mark legible at ~40px, no tiny tagline.
items.common_fail: Full-body shot; logo with unreadable small text.

items.full_marks: Handle sayable out loud in Iraqi, same across Instagram / TikTok / Facebook, Latin letters people can type after hearing it once.
items.common_fail: underscores and numbers nobody can spell (hus_office.iq_2).

items.full_marks: Posted within 7 days, comments on the latest post answered, a story up most days.
items.common_fail: Last post 5 weeks ago with unanswered 'بكم' comments under it.
